ad404f91-9265-4809-96f4-c1c6b3cab34f.user_provided_description:
About Us

Volopay is a Y Combinator-backed start-up that combines corporate cards, bill payments, approvals, expense reimbursements, and accounting automation into a single platform. We empower businesses to manage their financial operations seamlessly by providing real-time visibility, control, and automation over their spending.

We are backed by top investors and have expanded beyond Southeast Asia, now operating in the US to empower businesses with our innovative financial solutions.

We need people who are deeply excited about our vision and passionately curious about transforming the way businesses manage their finances.

Role Overview

We are looking for a driven and results-oriented Account Executive to own the sales process and build strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying opportunities, understanding customer needs, conducting product presentations, managing sales conversations, negotiating with prospects, and closing deals.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving problems, taking initiative, and making things happen. The role will be fast-paced, challenging, and at times ambiguous. You will not always get step-by-step instructions. You will be expected to figure things out, ask the right questions, execute quickly, and improve as you go.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative before being asked, can work through unclear problems, pays attention to detail, communicates clearly, and follows through on what they commit to.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification to discovery, product demonstrations, negotiation, and closing.

  • Build and manage a strong, qualified pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, account research, and consistent follow-ups.

  • Engage CFOs, finance leaders, business heads, and other key stakeholders to understand their operational and financial challenges.

  • Conduct structured discovery conversations and position Volopay's solutions based on customer needs and workflows.

  • Deliver compelling, value-driven product demonstrations tailored to customer requirements.

  • Drive opportunities forward through effective follow-ups, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.

  • Collaborate with Product, Onboarding, and other cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer journey.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline hygiene, and forecasting discipline.

  • Stay informed about competitor activity, pricing dynamics, market trends, and buyer behaviour across target markets.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed KPIs.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Ownership: Strong sense of ownership with the ability to independently manage responsibilities, take initiative without being asked, and follow through on commitments.

  • Independent Execution: Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and figure things out without requiring step-by-step instructions.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or a similar sales environment, with a preference for high-performing SDRs ready to transition into a full-cycle AE role.

  • A proven track record of exceeding targets, winning recognition, or being a top performer is highly valued.

  • Strong hunting and outbound sales capabilities, with the ability to independently generate and develop opportunities.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage the full sales cycle: prospect → meeting → discovery → demo → follow-up → close.

  • Strong understanding of consultative, value-based selling and the ability to sell business outcomes and financial workflows rather than just product features.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior decision-makers, including CFOs, finance leaders, and business heads.

  • Strong ownership of sales targets, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving go-to-market strategies.

  • Data-driven approach to sales performance, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • Experience selling to finance teams or multi-location businesses is a strong advantage.

  • Exposure to international markets and selling across different geographies is a plus.


Success in This Role

  • Build strong pipeline coverage across defined ICP segments.

  • Consistently generate qualified opportunities through effective outbound prospecting.

  • Conduct high-quality discovery and develop clear strategies for each opportunity.

  • Convert opportunities into predictable revenue through effective deal management.

  • Independently manage the full sales cycle and maintain strong pipeline discipline.

  • Collaborate effectively with Product and Onboarding teams.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed targets.


Work Location

  • Work From Office (WFO): This is a work-from-office role, and candidates are expected to work from the office.

  • Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Our Culture

At Volopay, you'll work alongside passionate and talented individuals who bring energy and curiosity to everything they do. Our diverse team includes musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and many others who bring unique perspectives and experiences.

We believe in giving people the independence and trust to take ownership, solve problems, and make an impact. Our culture is rooted in:

  • Ownership: We believe in freedom with responsibility. Take the lead, make decisions, and own your outcomes.

  • Results: We are a team of doers who stay focused on outcomes and overcome challenges with a can-do attitude.

  • Curiosity: We encourage curious minds to ask questions, learn continuously, wear multiple hats, and embrace new challenges.

Join Volopay and help shape the future of business finance while building your career in a high-growth, global fintech environment.

For selling a platform like this, we need people who are super excited about the vision of the company and who are passionately curious about building this for businesses out there.

The Role

We’re looking for an enthusiastic and adaptable Content Writer to create content and copy for our global website and blogs. This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their career who is passionate about writing, eager to learn, and comfortable adapting their writing style across different formats.

You may be a fresh graduate with a strong interest in content, or someone with 1–2 years of experience in content writing, copywriting, or digital marketing, preferably from an agency environment.

You’ll work on a variety of content formats, including articles, website copy, whitepapers, blogs, and direct-response copy. While content creation will be the primary focus, we’re looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, and willing to learn across different areas of marketing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Write clear, engaging, and user-friendly content for our global website, blogs, and other marketing channels.

  • Create content across different formats, including articles, blogs, landing pages, website copy, whitepapers, and direct-response copy.

  • Research industry trends, competitors, customer needs, and relevant topics to develop useful and engaging content.

  • Apply basic SEO principles, including keyword usage, content structure, readability, and on-page optimization.

  • Adapt writing style and tone based on the audience, content format, and brand guidelines.

  • Simplify complex financial and payment-related concepts into clear and easy-to-understand content.

  • Proofread and edit your own work to improve grammar, clarity, readability, and conciseness.

  • Draft, format, and publish articles and other content using our internal Content Management System (CMS). We are looking for someone comfortable learning basic CMS workflows, including content formatting, adding links and images, and managing on-page content elements.

  • Collaborate with the marketing team on campaigns, product messaging, customer education, and other content initiatives.

  • Support content requirements for product launches, campaigns, and other marketing activities.

  • Stay curious and continuously learn about content, SEO, digital marketing, and new content formats and practices.

  • Use AI tools and other relevant tools responsibly to improve content research and workflows while maintaining originality and quality.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Fresh graduates with strong writing skills are welcome to apply.

  • 1–2 years of experience in content writing, copywriting, or digital marketing is preferred, ideally in an agency or fast-paced environment.

  • Strong written and spoken English with excellent grammar and communication skills.

  • Ability to write across different formats, including articles, blogs, website copy, whitepapers, and marketing copy.

  • Basic understanding of SEO and content optimization.

  • Strong research skills and the ability to turn information into clear, engaging content.

  • Ability to adapt writing style based on the audience, platform, and brand voice.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to independently edit and proofread content.

  • Comfortable working with Content Management Systems (CMS) and learning new publishing tools and workflows.

  • Willingness to navigate a mild technical learning curve and handle basic technical aspects of content publishing.

  • Familiarity with Google Docs and common content/digital marketing tools.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of the content research and workflow process.

  • Most importantly, a strong willingness to learn, take feedback, experiment, and adapt.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment and meet deadlines.


Our Culture

At Volopay, you'll thrive among passionate, talented individuals who bring their energy into everything they do. Our team's diversity is our strength, with musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and more contributing their unique talents. Picture a workplace that's not just about work, but about a shared journey. We value your independence and trust you with tasks, encouraging you to take ownership and find innovative solutions. Our culture is rooted in:

  • Ownership: We believe in freedom with responsibility. You'll naturally take the lead and excel.

  • Results: We're doers who overcome obstacles with a can-do attitude.

  • Curiosity: Curious minds thrive here. Wear multiple hats and embrace new challenges.

Join Volopay for a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere where innovation thrives, and your individuality shines.

a501ce82-6593-4e9f-afd7-f83a0b0c433c.title: SEO Analyst
a501ce82-6593-4e9f-afd7-f83a0b0c433c.user_provided_description:
About the Role
Volopay is looking for an SEO Analyst to own organic growth end-to-end — from technical health and content strategy to team management and revenue impact. This isn't a role for someone who just wants rankings to go up; we need someone who connects SEO work to pipeline, works the numbers, and pushes the team to figure out what's actually driving (or blocking) growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own the organic growth strategy — technical SEO, content, and authority-building — and translate it into a working roadmap, not just a wishlist

  • Manage and mentor a team of content writers — set priorities, review quality, keep output on schedule

  • Diagnose why pages aren't ranking or converting, and fix the root cause instead of surface symptoms

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that track what matters — rankings, organic traffic, and lead quality and conversion, not just vanity metrics

  • Partner closely with the sales team to understand where leads come from, how they convert, and feed that back into content and targeting decisions

  • Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to automate repetitive SEO work — content gap analysis, reporting, rank tracking, audits — so the team spends time on strategy, not busywork

  • Run regular technical and content audits and flag/prioritize issues before they cost rankings

  • Stay ahead of how search itself is changing — AI answer engines, SGE/AI Overviews, changing SERP behavior — and adjust strategy accordingly, not just chase traditional rankings


What We're Looking For

  • Strong, demonstrated SEO skill — technical, content, and off-page — you can show us, not just tell us

  • Genuinely comfortable with data — you look at numbers before you have opinions, and you can build a dashboard or read Ahrefs/GSC/GA data without hand-holding

  • Can direct AI tools to do real work — not copy-paste, but actually prompt, iterate, and get usable output out of Claude/ChatGPT for research, reporting, or automation

  • Strategic thinker — you can go from "traffic is flat" to a prioritized 90-day plan without someone spelling out each step

  • Comfortable managing people — giving feedback, holding deadlines, unblocking a writer who's stuck

  • Confident working cross-functionally — you're not intimidated by sitting across from sales and defending your numbers

  • Self-driven — you learn new tools and SEO shifts on your own, you don't wait to be trained


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, SaaS, or B2B — understanding how organic content maps to a longer B2B sales cycle

  • Familiarity with tools like Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, or similar
